messages:
harper ng: heads-up: kicking off canary for route-optimizer v4 in the quiet window. we'll use feature flag `route.opt_v4` with a conservative ramp + surge-buffer backoff. start at 0.5%.

deploy-bot: deploy queued (db-99177). canary replicas: 3. healthchecks and auto-metrics hooks enabled.

cleo martinez: ramp plan proposal: 0.5% -> 3% @8m -> 12% @22m -> 30% @45m (manual hold) -> 60% @120m -> 100% @4h stable. backoff rule: if regional error spike >0.6% for >2m, do partial drain to previous step and pin. full rollback if global error_rate >1%.

zane yu: adding grace for KV/cache warmup: ignore p95 spikes shorter than 3m within first 10m of any step. will also raise tracing samples for 10m after 30% step.

oncall-bot: oncall will be paged at each manual holdpoint. auto-backoff actions enabled.

deploy-bot: canary scaled to 0.5%. healthchecks passing 3/3.

cleo martinez: moved to 3% @+9m. p95 +15ms, errors flat. advancing.

harper ng: prepping pin script: `curl -X POST https://internal/flags/pin -H '"Content-Type: application/json"' -d '{"flag":"route.opt_v4","version":"route-opt-v3","ttl":1800}'`

deploy-bot: reached 12% step. healthchecks: passing. next holdpoint at 30%.

zane yu: at 30% hold: traces look fine, but one host in eu-west shows a queueing pattern. note: if that host causes >2m spike, partial drain -> pin to v3 is preferred to full rollback.

cleo martinez: manual hold: paging oncall. please review and approve or flag rollback.

oncall-bot: oncall alerted. metrics: regional error spike in eu-west 0.8% lasting ~90s. below 2m window. no auto action yet.

harper ng: approve continue to 60% but arm partial drain rule: if any region crosses 0.6% for >2m, execute `partial_drain(step_delta=-1)` and pin to `route-opt-v3`.

deploy-bot: partial_drain action configured. backoff threshold set.

cleo martinez: at 60% we saw a 3m spike in us-east to 0.9% -> auto-backoff triggered. action: partial drain to 30% executed and flag pinned to `route-opt-v3` (ttl=1800s).

zane yu: thanks. collecting traces, initial signal points to a downstream timeout cluster. opening infra ticket.

harper ng: good automation — partial drain preserved overall rollout while protecting users. hold at 30% until infra confirms fix.

oncall-bot: flag pinned and TTL set. oncall continues monitoring.

cleo martinez: release notes draft: "route-optimizer v4: gradual FF rollout with surge-buffer backoff; partial-drain and pin on regional breaches; warmup guidance included." I'll push to release-notes repo.

harper ng: filing retro item to tune regional thresholds and the ignore-window heuristics. thanks team. :tada:
